scope: Saved-frame CPU replay, request serialization replay, original-photograph Glimmer concurrency check and offline contract regressions. No flight or Wonder inference.

native_tracker.scope: CPU replay of saved person-acquisition images using the actual baseline and final LiveTracker classes. Same frames, coherent SAM boxes, two-second exact-frame reseeding. No new capture, model call or flight.
limitations: SAM agreement is a proxy, not ground-truth accuracy.
Offline frames are JPEG-decoded; deployed final tracker consumes native pixels directly.
Timing covers tracker work; baseline includes its repeated JPEG decode. Capture and SAM latency are excluded.
This does not exercise asynchronous VisualFollow or establish browser, four-drone, live-flight or real-hardware acceptance.

request_process_isolation.scope: Actual Wonder request construction using original recorded 4K photographs in spawned worker processes. Mock HTTP transport only; no model, GPU or flight calls.

glimmer_review_concurrency.scope: Two saved original 4x 4K photographs, frozen Glimmer template and sampling, deployed Modal H200. Four review requests, no new photograph, Wonder call, flight or local GPU inference.
limitations: One pair per condition; same images and model slots may reuse cache. This does not establish four-drone or multi-environment capacity.

provenance.runner_usage: CPU-only saved-data replays and request serialization, passive GPU/telemetry reads, and four saved-photo Glimmer requests to the existing deployed server. No Wonder request, live flight, new model process, GPU benchmark or additional model deployment.

sources.claim: obj_id_to_score is first-frame detection score, used for out_probs; boxes bound the whole binary mask.
Connected-components statistics API and foreground pixel area.
Official CSRT setInitialMask API, evaluated as a candidate improvement, not a measured speed/accuracy gain.
to_thread is constrained by the GIL for CPU-bound code.
Documentation page fetch failed; the separately fetched exact-version official header verified the API.

acceptance_pending: Same-case user flight with browser tracking and WebRTC diagnostics, including acquisition, turns and brief occlusion.
Four simultaneous drones and one evidence photograph per new object; the two-photo Glimmer check is not a capacity qualification.
Installed fresh-frame capture/SAM cadence and source age; offline tracker speed is not aggregate inference or video FPS.
Browser CSRT alignment remains a separate implementation and is not qualified by native-tracker replay.
Renderer/encoder startup GPU-fence timeouts are unchanged and require a separate timing investigation.
On-demand evidence framing and motion at exposure need flight verification; the one-photo-per-object policy intentionally reuses historical evidence.
Real hardware requires calibrated optics and gimbal actuation/feedback.

preparation_validation.scope: Camera-only aiming toward the next observed route during airborne transit; capture and model inference remain gated to the observed step and polygon. Browser observer now uses the production scenario protocol, and the flight-plan explanation matches candidate priority and separate 4x evidence.
limitations: Camera preparation is covered by mocked mission/camera regressions; live-flight acquisition and framing remain for the operator test.

worker_bootstrap_repair.cause: A spawned review worker re-imported gcs.host and its flight-service dependencies from an editable deployment; geodesy.py no longer defined polygon_error while allocation.py still imported it. The worker exited and broke the review pool.
changes: Import flight-service dependencies only when the mission host or connection handler runs.
Install clean detached source with a private browser bundle; reject editable or shared deployments.
Exercise one-worker and four-worker pools with the actual mission-host spawn entry point before installation.

worker_probe.scope: Five CPU request workers with the actual gcs.host spawn entry point. No model, GPU, camera or flight request.

worker_bootstrap_repair.scope: No Wonder, Glimmer, SAM inference or flight request. Public and loopback assignment checks both returned HTTP 200 before cutover; no proxy trace ties the reported 502 to this worker failure.
